pokedexEntries.su: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It’s reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

pokedexEntries.mo: These Pokémon are cherished in the Alola region, where they are thought to be feminine deities of the land incarnate.

pokedexEntries.us: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it’s not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.

pokedexEntries.um: Its shining gold whiskers are advanced sensors that can detect vibrations from sounds several miles away.

pokedexEntries.lgpe: They’re referred to as triplets, but they’re not identical—the metallic elements in their bodies differ slightly. The proof shows in their whiskers!

pokedexEntries.sw: Their beautiful, metallic whiskers create a sort of protective helmet on their heads, and they also function as highly precise sensors.

pokedexEntries.sh: The three of them get along very well. Through their formidable teamwork, they defeat powerful opponents.
